_note: What a combatant can be suffering, and how a submitted set is cleaned up
Go holds the vocabulary in internal/http/conditions.go and refuses a PATCH
carrying anything outside it; TypeScript holds the same list in
lib/conditions.ts so the DM's picker can draw chips without asking the
server what exists. When the two drift the symptom is a picker offering a
condition the tracker then rejects, mid-fight, with the party waiting.
Normalisation is the part worth pinning. Both engines fold case, drop
duplicates, and sort into one canonical order, so that two DMs who toggled
the same three conditions in different orders produce the same row and the
tracker does not reshuffle its chips under them.
Exhaustion is the exception in every case below: one condition with six
levels, carried in the name, collapsing to the highest level submitted and
